arch.name: the Redrock Arch
arch.found: You stand under the Redrock Arch, a bridge of banded red stone nobody built. Wedged in a crack: a prospector's poke.

steamboat.name: the Belle of the Fen
steamboat.found: The Belle of the Fen, a sternwheeler sunk to her rails in the marsh. In the purser's strongbox:

lookout.name: the fire lookout
lookout.found: You climb the fire lookout. From the cabin you can see for miles: the county map fills in all round. Someone left a lump of amber on the sill.

schooner.name: the lost schooner
schooner.found: A prairie schooner, broken down and abandoned long ago. Under the seat, wrapped in an oilcloth:

babe.name: Babe the Blue Ox
babe.found: Babe the Blue Ox, Paul Bunyan's own, big as a barn and blue as a winter sky! She snuffles at your pack. She'd dearly love some apples.
babe.thanks: Babe crunches your apples, one, two, three, and leans her great blue head against you. Paul Bunyan's blessing goes with you now: every tree you fell gives an extra stick of wood.

hermit.name: the Hermit of the Hollows
hermit.found: Old Asa, the Hermit of the Hollows, looks up from his fire. "Company! Sit, sit." He talks for an hour, and by the end he has inked every strange place in the county onto your map: the arch, the wreck, the lookout, the lost wagon, the old birch, and where the blue ox grazes. He sends you off with a comb of honey.

birch.name: the Grandmother Birch
birch.found: The Grandmother Birch, older than the county, in her ring of toadstools. You rest a while in her shade and feel wholly mended. Tucked among her roots:
